mapper.select: select id, applicant_id, desired_level, scholarship_interest, intake_year, intake_term, teaching_language, notes from nad_applicant_interest where applicant_id = #{applicantId}
mapper.insert: insert into nad_applicant_interest (applicant_id, desired_level, scholarship_interest, intake_year, intake_term, teaching_language, notes, create_by, create_time) values (#{applicantId}, #{desiredLevel}, #{scholarshipInterest}, #{intakeYear}, #{intakeTerm}, #{teachingLanguage}, #{notes}, '', now())
mapper.update: update nad_applicant_interest set desired_level = #{desiredLevel}, scholarship_interest = #{scholarshipInterest}, intake_year = #{intakeYear}, intake_term = #{intakeTerm}, teaching_language = #{teachingLanguage}, notes = #{notes}, update_time = now() where applicant_id = #{applicantId}
mapper.select: select value from nad_applicant_interest_choice where applicant_id = #{applicantId} and kind = #{kind} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into nad_applicant_interest_choice (applicant_id, kind, value) values (#{applicantId}, #{kind}, #{v})
